title: Play can generate audio
summary:
Play gained audio generation, account access got simpler, and API errors and routes got a cleanup.

Play added audio generation with a voice selector based on each model’s available voices and a player for the result. Generated output now stays visible when switching models and clears on the next Generate click.

Login now preselects profile and balance permissions. Account documentation gained response schemas and examples for profile, balance, and usage, while the Pollen balance CSV link now points to the account usage route. The frontend also defaults to `gemini-fast` for text generation.

Azure GPT Image errors now retain the provider’s HTTP status and response body instead of turning rejected requests into 500s. Model Monitor also excludes all 4xx responses from its success-rate calculation.

daily.title: Generate audio in Play
daily.text: Choose an available voice, generate audio, and play the result without leaving Play. [Try Play](https://pollinations.ai/play).

daily.title: Account routes on the API
daily.text: Request your profile, balance, and usage through `gen.pollinations.ai/account/*`. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
